title: Tome
subtitle: A book on its side
description: A book seen from the front, turned ninety degrees -- which is what the rotation field is for, and
the reason every shape can be turned rather than a few of them having turned variants.
The outline is re-sampled at the angle rather than looked up from a second table, so the drawing,
the click and the icon's fit all come from the turned shape. The icon stays upright in the middle
of it, in the largest square that fits the turned outline.
